module.name: msrtsimul
module.description: MiniSEED real time playback and simulation

option.description: Increase verbosity. Use -v to print each record to stderr; use -vv for debug output.
Write on standard output. The output may be redirected to a specific mseedfifo path.
File with per-station artificial delays. One entry per line in the format 'NET.STA: seconds'.
Write directly to this named pipe path. Overrides --seedlink. Useful when the mseedfifo is not in the default location.
Only inject streams matching this pattern. Wildcards * and ? are accepted. May be specified multiple times, e.g. --filter AU.*.*.BHZ --filter IU.CTAO.*.*.
Minutes to skip at the beginning.

Inject jumped records at full speed instead of discarding them. Useful when downstream modules (e.g. scautomt) need a pre-event waveform buffer: --jump sets the window size and --inject-jump pushes those records into SeedLink at maximum speed before the real-time playback begins.
Repeat playback from the beginning when the file ends. Not valid when reading from stdin.
Playback mode: 'realtime' (default, record times shifted to now) or 'historic' (record times preserved).
The seedlink module name. Useful if a seedlink alias or non-standard names are used. Replaces 'seedlink' in the standard mseedfifo path.
Only inject records at or after this UTC time (ISO 8601, e.g. 2023-01-01T12:00:00). For large skips --jump is more efficient as it avoids pacing over skipped records.
Stop injecting records once they reach this UTC time (ISO 8601, e.g. 2023-01-01T13:00:00).
Maximum playback window in seconds. Combined with --start-time it sets an absolute end time; otherwise measured from the first injected record.
Test mode: read and process records but do not write output.
Allow miniSEED records of any size. By default only 512-byte records are passed to SeedLink. Records of other sizes can be repacked with msrepack from libmseed.
